profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary:
Articulate, multi-interest Mathematics major and Software Developer, I have a voracious appetite for knowledge, and I enjoy drawing on my research and experiences to find creative solutions to problems.  

Whether it's in the office, on client site, or in my favorite coffee shop, you will find me sitting over a computer with a big cup of coffee designing and debugging code, on the phone collaborating with clients and my team, or researching how best to solve client problems. 

A collegiate athlete (distance swimmer), I'm no stranger to commitment, discipline, and hard work, and I possess a keen appreciation for achievement and results.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer and Product Release Manager
positions.description:
Served as the technical visionary and lead architect for the product suite of the industry leader in midstream oil and gas pipeline forecasting. Managed and maintained product scope, resource allocation, senior management expectations, and customer requirements. Key speaker at all User Group Meetings (UGM).

●	Designed, coded and presented at UGM, presented a mobile application written in Xamarin and WebAPI targeted at users in the real-time Terminal Operation space.
●	Designed, coded and presented at UGM a PoC “Schedule Exchange” written in MVC to act as an information broker between customers with a web-based front end and an open REST API.
●	Designed a simulation regression tool and led a small team of four offshore contractors to implement it, with plans to expose the tool via a customer-facing web GUI to incentivize customer adoption of new releases.
●	Developed and implemented a new on-boarding and training program, which brought three new developers up to speed as active contributors in half the time.
●	Led weekly meetings with senior management to realign resources and initiatives.
●	Managed developer workload to maximize throughput with their compatible skill sets. 
●	Grew the development team's skill sets by introducing them to new technologies and concepts relative to their individual interests that align with product vision.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Designed and implemented custom applications for national and international clients.  Focus: requirements gathering and analysis, business analytics, improving reporting tools for data integrity, simulation options, custom visualizations, and integrations with internal databases and applications.

 • Designed, developed, and implemented a custom application for a Fortune 500 client, creating a standardized report generation tool to forecast inventory demand.
 • Analyzed and redesigned Legacy C++ Code to produce a reusable managed (C#) framework for application data archiving, thus future-proofing the archival process for the next version of a primary software suite.
 • Collaborated with Development Manager to create customizable WPF front end for Product Suite
 • Consumed custom RESTful interfaces for an industry leader in the midstream refined product market to import, route, and schedule nominations in a customizable manner to support the client’s business logic.
 • Sprinted regularly with a small team of developers to meet project deadlines.
 • Collaborated with customer IT liaisons to create a customizable web service to automatically back up data for disaster recovery.

positions.title: Student Tech Staff
positions.description: .  Worked 10+ hours per week in the StudentTech department. Diagnosed and repaired software and networking problems on both Windows and Macintosh platforms. Organized and implemented an annual technology fair ensuring all 300 incoming freshmen access to the campus computer network. Facilitated record-keeping of services and correspondence through Service Desk Express software.  As a senior StudentTech member, provided guidance to newer student staff members in procedures, client interaction, and troubleshooting.

positions.title: Intern Developer
positions.description: As a summer intern, applied SQL programming skills and knowledge of relational databases to support the business intelligence function of the nation’s fifth-largest writer of federally-sponsored crop insurance policies.  Transformed a series of .bat files and SQL queries and adapted them to run on a business intelligence server as a data warehouse. Implemented a structure to take comprehensive and specific snapshots of the company at daily, weekly, and monthly intervals. Designed and administered a SharePoint website and used mdx queries to "slice" the data in order to present it in a simple, comprehensive way while maintaining the option for executives to view detailed reports. Conceptualized and wrote a geocaching program using Google Maps API to monitor the geographic distribution of clients with respect to profit.
